shadows.name: active
shadows.purpose: 선택된 프로젝트 행과 transient status의 활성 계층

shadows.name: toolbox-drawer
shadows.purpose: 본문 위에 열린 우측 Toolbox overlay

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: 작업 정보 복사와 저장 같은 주요 행동
components.css: .ds-primary-action { min-height: 43px; border: 1px solid var(--fg-primary); border-radius: var(--radius-control); padding: 7px 12px; background: var(--fg-primary); color: var(--surface-primary); font: 750 var(--text-body)/var(--line-body) var(--font-ui); } .ds-primary-action:hover { filter: brightness(.94); } .ds-primary-action:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: 자료와 Toolbox 입력에 쓰는 compact field
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 5px; color: var(--fg-secondary); font: var(--text-caption)/1.55 var(--font-ui); } .ds-field input { border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: var(--radius-control); padding: 8px 10px; background: var(--surface-primary); color: var(--fg-primary); font: var(--text-body-sm)/1.55 var(--font-ui); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Top Bar
components.description: 브랜드, 로컬 연결, Toolbox와 설정을 한 줄에 모은 상단 bar
components.html:
ThreadDock
로컬 연결 정상
components.css: .ds-top-bar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 20px; padding: 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); background: var(--surface-primary); color: var(--fg-primary); font-family: var(--font-ui); } .ds-top-bar strong { margin-right: auto; font-size: 24px; letter-spacing: -.04em; } .ds-top-bar strong span { color: var(--action-primary); } .ds-connection { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: var(--fg-secondary); font-size: var(--text-body-sm); } .ds-status-mark { display: inline-block; width: 8px; height: 8px; flex: 0 0 auto; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--status-success); } .ds-top-bar button { min-height: 36px; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: var(--radius-control); padding: 7px 12px; background: var(--surface-primary); color: var(--fg-primary); font-weight: 700; } .ds-top-bar button:hover { background: var(--surface-canvas); } .ds-top-bar button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Selected Work Row
components.description: 선택된 업무를 inset cobalt bar와 tonal surface로 구분하는 목록 행
components.css: .ds-work-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 58px minmax(0,1fr) 72px; align-items: center; gap: 12px; width: 100%; min-height: 48px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); padding: 0 10px; background: var(--surface-canvas); color: var(--fg-primary); box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 var(--action-primary); text-align: left; font-family: var(--font-ui); } .ds-work-row span, .ds-work-row small { color: var(--fg-secondary); font-size: var(--text-body-sm); } .ds-work-row:hover { filter: brightness(.99); } .ds-work-row:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Toolbox Drawer
components.description: 본문을 재배치하지 않고 우측에 겹치는 사람용 복사·Todo 표면
components.html:
빠른 작업

실행하지 않고 필요한 명령만 복사합니다.
components.css: .ds-toolbox-drawer { width: min(480px,92vw); min-height: 320px; border-left: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); background: var(--surface-primary); color: var(--fg-primary); box-shadow: -1rem 0 2.625rem rgba(23,33,54,.16); font-family: var(--font-ui); } .ds-toolbox-drawer header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding: 25px 24px 18px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); } .ds-toolbox-close { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 34px; height: 34px; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: var(--radius-control); background: transparent; color: var(--fg-primary); } .ds-toolbox-close svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; } .ds-toolbox-close path { fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-width: 1.7; } .ds-toolbox-drawer nav { display: flex; gap: 18px; padding: 18px 24px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); } .ds-toolbox-tab { border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; padding: 0 0 11px; background: transparent; color: var(--fg-secondary); } .ds-toolbox-tab.ds-active { border-color: var(--action-primary); color: var(--fg-primary); font-weight: 750; } .ds-toolbox-drawer button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-toolbox-drawer p { padding: 20px 24px; color: var(--fg-secondary); font-size: var(--text-body-sm); }
